card.name: Zero digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: Mostly the digit 0 (sometimes 9) in the middle of a multi-digit dose or volume number, such as 10,000 units, 600 mg or 100 mL. Also a few odd spots like partway through 'fecal' or 'Complicated'.

modes.label: Digit inside dose number
modes.description: A zero or other digit within a number followed by units like mg, units or mL.

modes.description: Scattered cases inside a medical word, such as fecal or complicated.
